stages.prompt:
Your primary task is to construct research ideas from the brief.
Read IDEA_CHECK.md. Produce 3 distinct ideas, each with id, title, idea,
and motivation as nonempty strings, in a top-level ideas array in result.json.
Explain the proposed conceptual move clearly enough to compare with existing work.
Use formulas only when they help; an informal research direction is sufficient.
Choose ideas for their potential to open a new research direction. Solving the idea
now, a working implementation, accessible data, a full proof, experimental evidence,
and immediate verifiability are NOT prerequisites. Preserve ambitious, unresolved ideas.
Use public sources for inspiration as useful. A separate final check handles closest
prior work and obvious mathematical mistakes. Do not execute scientific experiments.
Save a Chinese IDEAS.md and the runtime's six standard result fields.

This run specifically requires substantive CROSS-DISCIPLINARY research ideas. Read all supplied
domain cards. Available discipline names: ["Non-equilibrium statistical physics", "Evolutionary ecology", "Immunology and immune memory", "Economics and mechanism design"].
Generate 3 distinct proposals spanning different disciplinary combinations, rather than
three variations of one method. A crossing must alter the question, representation, explanatory
mechanism, or organizing principle. Merely applying an AI model to a new dataset or relabeling a
known optimization is a weak starting point. You may go beyond the exact ideas in the cards.
For every idea add domains (at least two exact names from the list), research_question,
conceptual_move, why_this_crossing_matters, and concept_mapping (at least two objects containing
source_concept, target_counterpart, transfer, where_analogy_may_break as strings).
Write the core proposal concretely enough to recognize similar prior directions. A clear
conceptual proposal is enough; do not invent a decorative equation or demand a complete theory.
Keep ambitious ideas even when a solution is unknown. No experimental plan, accessible-data
requirement, or proof is needed. Novelty and broad mathematical coherence will be checked ONLY
after this complete batch is saved. Save every candidate; do not screen or reject them here.
